name: W-meter-abstains
says: One restWhole (read 4.0q), nothing else in the bar. Q.METER on this system ABSTAINS (carry_not_corroborated); the FILE writes 6/8 here anyway, so 2.8 sums 4.0 against 3.0 and HOLDS the bar. size_measure_rest needs a DECIDED meter to mark it.
